pages.text: $(d)Imbues$() are special potions that are created in the $(l:irregular_implements:blocks/imbuing_station)Imbuing Station$(/l). They provide powerful long-lasting effects when consumed.$(br2)However, you can only have a single Imbue at a time. Drinking a new Imbue will replace your current one.

$(d)Available Imbues$()$(br2)$(li)$(d)Fire Imbue$(): Melee attacks set targets on fire.$(br)$(li)$(d)Poison Imbue$(): Melee attacks inflict Poison II.$(br)$(li)$(d)Wither Imbue$(): Melee attacks inflict Wither II.$(br)$(li)$(d)Experience Imbue$(): Double experience from slain mobs.$(br)$(li)$(d)Spectre Imbue$(): 10% chance to completely negate incoming damage.$(br)$(li)$(d)Collapse Imbue$(): Melee attacks inflict $(l:irregular_implements:blocks/sakanade_spores)Collapse$(/l).
